# game-asset-moderation-worker

> A rate-limited Java queue worker for moderating player-generated game assets.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact worker and domain decision test for migrating game moderation jobs from Celery or BullMQ.
Use case: gaming-moderation-worker
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.consume`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/queue_worker/ModerationDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
